work.summary: Rewrote CareRev's React-based Facility app as a modern Elm application, on a platform that helps hospitals staff qualified nurses and gives nurses control of their careers.
highlights: Re-architected the start of CareRev's React to Elm rewrite
Shipped high-impact features and services like Smart Rates to high-profile clients, saving them time and money
Mentored junior engineers and trained senior engineers on pure functional concepts
Onboarded engineers of every skill level into an Elm codebase, and set the code practices and standards for Elm development

work.summary: Rebuilt Halogen and integrated it into Triller's platform after the acquisition, adding live streaming and a web app to their suite of tools.
highlights: Built the scheduled-stream and livestreaming tools used by artists like Jennifer Lopez and DJ Khaled to entertain thousands of fans
Powered the Verzuz battle series, including realtime audience voting during broadcasts
Reverse engineered web applications to bridge Halogen with Triller's existing platform

work.summary: Built Halogen, a live streaming platform for artists and creatives, using Elm, JavaScript, and Web Components.
highlights: Grew Halogen past 120k lines of Elm; the platform was acquired by Triller
Led the upgrade from Elm 0.18 to 0.19 and the migration from BEM-style CSS to TailwindCSS
Onboarded and trained React engineers in Elm and functional programming
Shipped tipping, gifting, chat, and live and prerecorded playback features
Applied modern responsive design practices to support both mobile and desktop viewers
Delivered robust features in short sprints with engineers, designers, and stakeholders, using agile practices to absorb changing requirements and shortened deadlines

work.summary: Helped rewrite an aging PHP application using React and Redux with middleware (redux-observable, redux-saga).
highlights: Learned to structure a large React/Redux application
Picked up the fundamentals of observables with RxJS and honed functional programming skills

work.summary: Taught and supported students across HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js, responsive design, Heroku, Git, user authentication, Laravel, React.js, MySQL, and MongoDB. Graded homework and provided in-class and virtual assistance.

Discovered a lasting passion for education and mentoring
